deck.title: Cozy AI Deploy — shipping your AI app, minus the DevOps dread

props.title:
Shipping your AI app,
==minus the DevOps dread.==
props.subtitle: A friendly deployment companion for AI-built apps — from 'it works in the builder' to 'it's live'.

slides.notes: Set the tone: this is a cozy tool with a serious job. Creating an app got easy — getting it online didn't. Cozy AI Deploy closes that gap.

right.label: On deploy day
right.title: A dozen sharp edges
points: The gap between preview and live

slides.notes: Empathize with the stall: builders made creating the easy part, but between 'it works' and 'it's live' sit servers, env vars, DNS, certs. That's where momentum dies.

props.title: A calm, guided path ==from built to deployed.==

items.title: The steps you actually need
items.body: In order, nothing extra — exactly what stands between your project and a live URL.

items.title: Human language
items.body: Every prompt and message explained in plain words, no jargon without a translation.

items.title: Checks along the way
items.body: Each stage confirms before you move on, so the next step never surprises you.

slides.notes: The pitch in one line: guided, ordered, explained, verified. No dashboard archaeology, no forum spelunking.

items.title: Connect the project
items.body: Point Cozy at your AI-built app and it maps what you have.

items.title: Walk the checklist
items.body: Config, secrets, domain, go-live verification — checked off in order, in plain language.

items.title: Land on a live URL
items.body: Confidence instead of superstition: every box ticked before it's public.

slides.notes: Walk through the flow briefly. Emphasize go-live verification — the live URL is the finish line, not the leap of faith.

props.label: Cozy by design
props.text: Warm tone. No jargon without a translation. And nothing irreversible happens ==without a clear heads-up first.==

slides.notes: Let this breathe. This is the product philosophy: reassurance is a feature, not decoration. Especially the irreversibility guardrail.

tiles.title: Guided deploy checklist
tiles.body: Config, secrets, domain, and verification — one clear path, in order.

tiles.title: Plain-language everything
tiles.body: Every error and prompt comes with a human translation.

tiles.title: Secrets handled safely
tiles.body: Environment variables set once, kept out of your code and chat logs.

tiles.title: Domain & DNS walkthrough
tiles.body: Records, certificates, and HTTPS — explained before you touch them.

tiles.title: Go-live verification
tiles.body: Nothing ships until the checks say it's really live.

slides.notes: Hit the highlights, don't read every tile. The accent tile — the guided checklist — is the core.

props.title: A working tool, ==open source==.
props.body: Cozy AI Deploy is real and shipping today. Read the code, fork it, file issues, or make it yours — it lives in the open at github.com/Mike-Demo/cozy-ai-deploy.

slides.notes: Credibility beat: this isn't a concept. It works, and the code is public — that's the invitation to trust and to contribute.

props.title: Your app is built. ==Let's get it live.==
props.subtitle: Star it, fork it, or deploy with it — warm hugs and green checkmarks await.

slides.notes: Close with the call to action: visit the repo, try it on your next AI-built app. Thank the audience.
